column3: The character from the FIRST image is H: keep him EXACTLY the same (bald, white letter H on the forehead, big muscular body, black shorts, olive tactical belt, black wrist wraps), same semi-realistic comic illustration style with detailed shading, NOT flat or 2D. The character from the SECOND image is KABIR: keep him exactly the same (lean wiry man, messy black hair, stubble, grey tank top, dark track pants). Horizontal 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, 1280x720, one big simple idea, readable on a small phone. Plain flat light blue background (#CCD8F0), nothing else in the background. A simple arm-wrestling table in the middle, side view. KABIR (thin, calm, bored, sipping from a small cup with his free hand) has slammed H's huge hand flat onto the table; H (huge) is bent over the table, shocked face looking straight at the viewer, sweat drops flying. A big white stopwatch icon above the table shows "0:04". Top-left: big dark navy extra-bold italic text "4 SECONDS?!". No other text.
